prompt_en: Create a complex nocturnal botanical-forensics scene in a moonlit orchid conservatory. A self-contained original adult subject, an unmistakably adult forensic botanist, reconstructs a luminous pollen-transfer path, aligning clear measurement panels between rare blooms while numbered evidence dishes and a macro camera document the trace. Frame a waist-up environmental portrait, frontal with only a slight turn. Show an oval face contour: hairline temples cheek edges jawlines and chin remain visible; the face is moderately longer than wide; the zygomatic region is subtly widest while the forehead and jaw are somewhat narrower; the jaw narrows smoothly into a rounded chin without an abrupt angular corner; neutral expression and controlled perspective preserve the actual contour while soft light and restrained makeup clarify it. Her hair is swept fully behind both temples and jaw edges as one hand places a panel. Greenhouse moonlight and a diffused field lamp share one gentle facial modeling direction. Render photorealistically, with accurate orchid textures, clear glass reflections, fine pollen glow, natural skin texture, and dimensional background depth. Avoid: over-processed retouching, illustration look, inaccurate reflections, excessive HDR, cartoon style, 3D render look, warped product geometry, fake-looking background, low resolution
